subject: reasoning
question:
How many triangles are there in the following figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/718a335ef7c579d594055e0c1d2386c54d97d3736c1a55651cd3aa422664bff6.png]
solution:
The number of triangles in the given figure is shown below:

1) Number of triangles = {n(n + 2)(2n + 1)over 8} , Where; n = 4 (number of triangles at the baseline)

= {4(4 + 2)(2 times 4 + 1)over 8}

= {4(6)(8 + 1)over 8}</
